title: Rational power sums: Faulhaber formula
statement: Let $b_0,b_1,\ldots\in\mathbf Q$ be the Bernoulli numbers, defined by $b_0=1$ and $b_r=-\frac1{r+1}\sum_{j=0}^{r-1}\binom{r+1}{j}b_j$ for $r\ge1$. For each integer $p\ge0$ define the rational polynomial $F_p(X)=\sum_{j=0}^{p}b_j\binom{p+1}{j}X^{p+1-j}/(p+1)\in\mathbf Q[X]$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring]. For all integers $n,p\ge0$, with $0^0=1$, one has $\displaystyle\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}i^p=F_p(n)$ in $\mathbf Q$, where an empty sum is zero.
